# ubiqo

> Self-hosted context fabric for AI clients: org → project hierarchy, git-backed
> semver'd shared artifacts, scoped memories, activity digests, and compiled
> per-project instructions, distributed into Claude Code / Claude Desktop / any
> MCP client via 12 ubiqo_* tools plus fail-open session hooks. Apache-2.0.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): quickstart, demo script, security posture, comparison
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/ubiqo-architecture.md): five-plane design, data model, day-in-the-life
- [ADRs](docs/adr/): the eight load-bearing decisions (exec-git, device tokens, RBAC, framing…)
- [Productization review](docs/reviews/2026-07-13-productization-review.md): 8-perspective review synthesis and phase plan
- [Research](docs/research/omni-gap-analysis.md): why Omni/Basic Memory/mem0 don't fill this niche
- [Restore runbook](docs/runbooks/restore.md): backup/restore/fsck, failure-mode matrix

## Source map
- cmd/ubiqo: single binary — serve, migrate, setup, seed, admin, backup, fsck, login/init/hooks
- internal/core: service façade (RBAC gate, git-first mutations, framing)
- internal/mcpserver: the MCP tool surface (deny-by-default registry)
- internal/gitstore: exec-git artifact plane (bare repos, merges, release tags)
- internal/compiler: context bundle compiler (golden-tested)
- internal/store: Postgres control plane (+ embedded migrations)
- internal/httpapi: /mcp, /healthz, /readyz, /metrics, /v1/meta, hook REST
- clients/claude-plugin: Claude Code plugin (marketplace at repo root)
